name: tellmoreai-admin-mobile
description: The ADMIN app: a Capacitor shell that opens https://www.tellmoreai.com/admin in its own WebView. A separate Android app from the one in mobile/ (owner, 2026-09-24: 'the admin app and the user app will be separated'), with its own package id, its own icon and its own notifications. Fewer plugins than the user app on purpose — the console never takes a photo, records a voice note or asks for a location.
